parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for the human androgen receptor target CHEMBL1871. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key, and join docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1871 and standard_type IC50. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication, preserving row multiplicity. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
